label: SHEIN Marketplace
terms_note: SHEIN Marketplace seller (US / EU / MX / BR marketplaces per registry research) plus an Open Platform account; every application is reviewed by SHEIN before authorisation integration; documentation and auth details are inside the account; no sandbox or rate limit text public.

discovery.auth: api_key + seller authorisation (Open Platform account → application → review → 'Authorization Integration'; key/secret details in the documents, not public)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes**.Confidence: **medium** — official Open Platform home opened;
auth: 1. Apply for an Open Platform account (seller or service provider).
2. Create an application; SHEIN reviews it.
3. Authorization integration (seller grants the app access) → solution integration.

endpoints.purpose: orders; upload tracking number; update order status

reference.limits: Not public. - Open Platform account + application review. - Seller authorisation per shop.
mcp_sdk: none official found in the pages opened

config_fields.name: random_key
config_fields.help: The 5-character RandomKey you choose (letters/digits, e.g. 'test1'); it prefixes every x-lt-signature and must equal the last 5 characters of sign_key.

config_fields.name: site
config_fields.help: SHEIN sub-site for price and shelf changes, e.g. shein-us, shein-mx, shein-fr (店铺站点和币种信息 /open-api/openapi-business-backend/site/query).

config_fields.name: currency
config_fields.help: Selling currency of that site for price changes, e.g. USD, MXN, EUR.

config_fields.name: warehouse_code
config_fields.help: Merchant warehouse code (from `me`) for stock updates; required when the store has several warehouses.

fields.name: open_key_id
fields.help: openKeyId returned by the store-authorisation call /open-api/auth/get-by-token (Store Authorization Application Manual); sent as x-lt-openKeyId.

fields.name: sign_key
fields.help: The HMAC key SHEIN's Signature Rules define as SecretKey + RandomKey: the DECRYPTED secretKey from /open-api/auth/get-by-token (it is returned AES-encrypted with your appSecretKey; decrypt it once as the authorisation manual shows) immediately followed by your random_key, e.g. '6BEC9C4B668B4B14B17EEF106BB98AE5test1'. Never sent on the wire.

me.note: 商家仓库列表查询: the store's warehouses (warehouseCode, warehouseName, saleCountryList, warehouseType 1 = merchant warehouse); verifies openKeyId and signature.

list_orders.note: 请求订单列表: orders issued on ONE calendar day — `since` (YYYY-MM-DD, required) selects that day 00:00:00–23:59:00 in Beijing time (the API accepts at most a 48-hour window). `status` is SHEIN's numeric orderStatus: 1 pending, 2 to ship, 3 awaiting SHEIN shipment, 4 shipped, 5 delivered, 6 refunded, 7 awaiting pickup, 8 reported lost, 9 rejected. Line items: /open-api/order/order-detail (not mapped).

set_inventory.note: 更新商家库存接口v2: overwrites the merchant virtual stock of SHEIN sku_code `sku` (required) with `quantity` (reserved/occupied units cannot be removed). Per-SKU failures are in raw.info.failedList.

update_listing.note: 更新商品售价: sets the shop price of SKU `listing_id` (SHEIN sku_code) on the configured site/currency; the special price is reset. status 1 = done, 2 = waiting for price review (wait for the review webhook before changing it again), 0 = failed.

end_listing.note: 商品上下架: takes SKC `listing_id` (skc_name) off the shelf on the configured site. The same SKC+site cannot be changed again within 20 minutes; check `failures`.

not_offered.create_listing: 商品发布/编辑 (/open-api/goods/product/publishOrEdit, https://open.sheincorp.com/documents/apidoc/detail/3002018) needs the leaf category, attribute template values, brand, SKC/SKU structures and images uploaded through /open-api/goods/transform-pic; the vocabulary's create_listing inputs cannot build it.
not_offered.mark_shipped: 批量上传运单号 (https://open.sheincorp.com/documents/apidoc/detail/3001274) requires per-item 'goodsId' (required; 'each piece has a different goodsId, obtained from the order detail API') and an 'expressIdCode' from the ship-channel query; mark_shipped has only order_id, carrier and tracking_number.

adapter.terms: SHEIN Open Platform: every call carries x-lt-openKeyId, x-lt-timestamp (ms) and x-lt-signature = RandomKey + Base64(hex(HMAC-SHA256(key = SecretKey + RandomKey, OpenKeyId + '&' + Timestamp + '&' + Path))) (Signature Rules, https://open.sheincorp.com/documents/system/passwdrule). Apps are created on the Open Platform and each store authorises them (tempToken → openKeyId + encrypted secretKey).

live_check.notes: requires open_key_id, sign_key, random_key; started, listed tools and answered a clean auth_error naming the variables
